details: Agricultural practice includes soil preparation, crop cultivation, animal husbandry, horticulture, forestry, pisciculture (fish farming), and sericulture (silk production)
Evolution spans from ancient Harappan ploughing and traditional oxen-driven farming to modern diesel tractors, motorized transplanters, and combine threshers
evidence_or_examples: Dal Lake floating vegetable markets in Srinagar; ancient Harappan wooden plough models

details: Over 70% of rural working women in India are engaged in agriculture, managing sowing, transplanting, weeding, harvesting, and cattle care
Ancient Sanskrit text Krishi Parashara outlines management principles: daily farm visits, cattle welfare, seasonal awareness, seed selection, and industrious work
evidence_or_examples: Krishi Parashara verse: 'A farmer who looks after cattle, visits farms daily, knows seasons... never perishes'

branches.theme: Soil Profile, Climate, and Cropping Seasons

details: Alluvial Soil: Deposited by river systems in Indo-Gangetic Plains & deltas; rich in potash and humus; highly fertile for rice, wheat, sugarcane
Black Soil (Regur): Volcanic basalt origin in Deccan Trap (MH, GJ, MP); high clay content & moisture retention; ideal for cotton and jowar
Red & Yellow Soil: Formed on crystalline igneous rocks in Deccan edges; red hue from iron diffusion; suitable for millets, groundnut, pulses
Laterite Soil: Result of intense tropical leaching in heavy rainfall zones (Western Ghats, Meghalaya); supports tea, coffee, cashew, rubber
evidence_or_examples: Soil drainage laboratory experiment showing high water retention in clayey soil vs rapid permeability in sandy soil

details: Kharif Season: South-West monsoon crops; sown June-July, harvested Sept-Oct; crops include Paddy (Rice), Maize, Jowar, Bajra, Cotton, Groundnut
Rabi Season: Winter crops; sown Oct-Nov, harvested March-April; crops include Wheat, Barley, Gram, Mustard, Peas
Zaid Season: Short summer season (March to June); produces Watermelon, Muskmelon, Cucumber, vegetables, and fodder
evidence_or_examples: Rice transplantation during South-West monsoon rains in Punjab, UP, and West Bengal

branches.theme: Irrigation, Water Resources, and Sustainable Practices

details: Transition from rainfed farming, wells, tanks, and Persian wheels to modern tube wells, canal networks, and motorized pumps
Over-extraction of groundwater leads to falling water tables, soil salinity, and ecological degradation in arid/semi-arid regions
evidence_or_examples: Over-pumping of aquifers in Punjab and Rajasthan leading to groundwater depletion

details: Adoption of micro-irrigation systems: Drip Irrigation (delivers water directly to roots drop-by-drop) and Sprinkler Irrigation
Sustainable techniques: Organic composting, vermicomposting, crop rotation, intercropping, rainwater harvesting, and bio-pesticides
evidence_or_examples: Drip irrigation implementation in sugarcane and horticulture farms of Maharashtra and Rajasthan
